Use the following data to plot it: category_names = ['Football', 'Volleyball', 'Basketball', 'Formula 1', 'Tennis'], results = {'USA': [12, 13, 15, 34, 28], 'UK': [22, 26, 32, 12, 10], 'Germany': [31, 32, 15, 6, 20], 'Spain': [30, 13, 11, 12, 35], 'China': [25, 24, 8, 3, 43], 'Italy': [18, 9, 15, 25, 30]}. Requirements:
- The bars must be horizontal.
- Set the title to exactly `Favorite Sports by Country`.
- Show a legend naming the five sports.
- Do NOT use the jet, rainbow or hsv colormaps.
- Save the figure at 120 dpi.
- Make the figure 9 by 5 inches.
Save the figure as figure.png.

    bottom += data[i]

# Set title

# Add legend
ax.legend(title='Sports', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Save figure
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('figure.png', dpi=120, bbox_inches='tight')

print("Figure saved as figure.png")
EOF

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

category_names = ["Football", "Volleyball", "Basketball", "Formula 1"]
results = {
    "USA": [12, 13, 15, 34, 28],
    "UK": [22, 26, 32, 12, 10],
    "Germany": [31, 32, 15, 6, 20],
    "Spain": [30, 13, 11, 12, 35],
    "China": [25, 24, 8, 3, 43],
    "Italy": [18, 9, 15, 25, 30],
}
labels = list(results.keys())
data = np.array(list(results.values()))[:, :len(category_names)]
data_cum = data.cumsum(axis=1)
category_colors = plt.colormaps["RdYlGn"](np.linspace(0.15, 0.85, data.shape[1]))

horizontal = False
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5))
total = np.sum(data, axis=1).max()
lower = 0
if horizontal:
    ax.invert_yaxis()
    ax.set_xlim(lower, total)
else:
    ax.set_ylim(lower, total)
for i, (colname, color) in enumerate(zip(category_names, category_colors)):
    widths = data[:, i]
    starts = data_cum[:, i] - widths
    rects = ax.barh(labels, widths, left=starts, height=0.5, label=colname, color=color) if horizontal else ax.bar(labels, widths, bottom=starts, width=0.5, label=colname, color=color)
    r, g, b, _ = color
    text_color = "white" if 0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b < 0.5 else "black"
    ax.bar_label(rects, label_type="center", color=text_color)
ax.legend(ncols=len(category_names), bbox_to_anchor=(0, 1), loc="lower left", fontsize="small")
ax.set_title("Favorite Sports by Country", pad=28)
fig.tight_layout()
